description_en: Deletes a metadata entity definition, including custom entity types and extension table types
description_zh: 删除元数据实体定义（包含纯自定义类型和扩展表类型）
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public delete-meta-entity-def --entity-type custom_entity-customer_api --biz-force true --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteMetaEntityDef

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to force delete the entity definition. Default value: false. Valid values:

true: Automatically deletes all entity objects created under this entity type.
false: Checks whether entity objects exist under this entity type. If objects exist, the deletion is failed
parameters.help_zh:
是否强制删除，默认为false
true，会自动删除这个实体类型下创建的实体对象
false，会校验实体类型下是否有对象存在，如果存在则删除失败
parameters.name: force
